subject: Data retention & deletion — proposed playbook + SOC 2 / questionnaire next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Data retention & deletion — proposed playbook + SOC 2 / questionnaire next steps

Hi Claire — thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on Healix's security/data-retention asks:

- Items you raised: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA controls, vendor questionnaire, specifics on logs/backups retention and deletion certification.
- What we can share immediately: our current security pack (SOC 2 Type I & controls matrix; SOC 2 Type II run in progress with estimated report delivery in mid-June), encryption & KMS practices, and our log/backup retention baseline.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) I attach a short "retention playbook" summary and the Redwood Security Pack (PDF).
2) Please send over the vendor questionnaire you mentioned — we'll map answers and flag items that need engineering/legal review.
3) If you want a technical deep-dive, we can schedule a 30–45 minute call next week with our platform engineer to walk through snapshot lifecycle and deletion flows.

Baseline retention details (summary):
- Application logs: default 90 days; configurable per-customer window.
- Audit logs (security/trace): retained 365 days.
- Backups: incremental backups retained 30 days; full snapshots retained up to 12 months by default.
- Deletion flow: soft-delete (30-day recoverability window) then queued for irreversible purge; upon a formal deletion request we trigger snapshot purges across replicas and issue a deletion certificate within 60 days.

Notes on HIPAA/GDPR: we support BAA for HIPAA-covered customers and have data processing addenda available. We also provide tools to support subject access requests (SARs) and erasure workflows; some items require coordination with your legal team for scope and proof.

Next steps for us: please upload the questionnaire or confirm the preferred format (Excel/Doc/online form). If you can identify one or two items you consider blockers (e.g., retention shorter than 90 days, inability to provide deletion certificate), call them out and we’ll prioritize.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap and the attached pack (I had a quick skim). A couple of clarifying questions before we route the questionnaire to our compliance team:

1) You listed "incremental backups 30 days / snapshots 12 months" — can you confirm whether snapshot retention is configurable per customer and whether snapshots are geo-replicated by default?
2) For the deletion certificate: is the 60-day window a SLA commitment or an operational estimate? We need clarity for our procurement team — they expect a timeline in the MSA.
3) Regarding SOC 2 Type II: you mentioned an estimated delivery in mid-June. Do you have an auditor name and a copy of the scope we can share with our audit team?

Also attaching our vendor questionnaire (Excel) — please have the engineering/security team fill tab A (technical controls) and tab C (encryption/backup). If possible, add an initial answer in the "Healix review" column so our team can see what's feasible.

One other ask: our legal lead (Alex) would like confirmation that Redwood supports overwrite/crypto-shredding for keys as a deletion mechanism where applicable for encrypted backups.

Thanks — Claire

--
Claire Ramos

Healix Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 11:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data retention & deletion — proposed playbook + SOC 2 / questionnaire next steps

Claire — thanks for the quick follow-up and for the attached questionnaire. We completed the first-pass answers and attached the following to this thread:
- Redwood_Security_Pack_2028_v1.pdf (controls matrix, encryption, KMS practice, SOC 2 Type I evidence).
- Healix_Vendor_Questionnaire_2028_filled.xlsx (tab A/C completed; see "Notes" column for items that need legal/engineer review).

Answers to your clarifying questions:
1) Snapshot retention & geo-replication: snapshots are configurable per-customer. By default, we replicate snapshots to a secondary region within the same geographic region (e.g., us-west -> us-east). Cross-region replication to outside the primary region is available as an opt-in configuration and can be constrained by data residency requirements. We noted this in Tab C.
2) Deletion certificate SLA: we can commit to providing a deletion certificate within 60 calendar days of a validated deletion request as part of a custom MSA term for customers on Enterprise plans (this is not in the default hosted agreement but is offered to Dedicated/Private customers or via contract addendum). We flagged the contract option in the filled questionnaire.
3) SOC 2 Type II: the engagement is with Redwood Auditing LLP (external auditor). Scope: infrastructure and production inference platform (auth, access control, logging, incident response). Estimated report delivery: mid-June 2028. We can provide a TEA (testing evidence abstract) to your audit team under NDA prior to full report release.

On key overwrite/crypto-shredding: we support key rotation and controlled key deletion via KMS. For encrypted backups where keys are customer-managed (BYOK), a key destruction event yields practical crypto-shredding; we capture that in our deletion certification flow and documented in the Security Pack (see section 4.2). Where Redwood manages keys, we provide secure key destruction and an auditable process; legal should review the exact wording for MSA.

Action items (what we'll do now):
- Ben will schedule a 45-minute technical call with your platform engineer and our infra PM to walk through snapshot lifecycle and deletion playbook.
- Laura will route the filled questionnaire to our engineering security lead for any deep technical evidence.
- We will prepare a draft SLA addendum (deletion certificate clause) and attach to the deal portal for your review.

If this aligns, Ben/Laura—can you take the scheduling and DocuSign steps? Claire/Alex — what times next week look best for a 45-minute session?

Best,
Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
